title: fixRAgent connection settings
description: Everything here is optional. With no key, try_sample works and assess_property_photo reads up to 3 real photos per caller in a rolling 24 hours (under a shared daily ceiling); past that it returns a stored SAMPLE and says so. get_triage_profile needs no key.

triageKey.title: fixRAgent key (optional)
triageKey.description: Your fixRAgent key, issued free at https://fixragent.com/docs#key. Sent to https://fixragent.com/mcp as the x-triage-key header. A key lifts the keyless cap: 60 assessments a day.
